title: I tried paying about 5 gamedevs for a soccer game before ai
author: Negative-Carob-6122
selftext: and they all refused, maybe they were not good with this kind of games and ball physics but I'm happy that I finally have the freedom to  make something funny and a game i wish for, because before claude no one wanted to help me

comments.author: WorldSuspicious9171
comments.body:
Oh it wasn't the physics I'm guessing... Probably the prospect of having to get 21 other glue sniffers to respond and act like actual soccer players.

But, you are right, you can now try and make your dreamgame, have fun mate ;)

replies.author: Negative-Carob-6122
replies.body: it was for a roblox game on fiver, they had their prices, I said my game idea and ask how much I had to pay and they just refused lol

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: a few post on here re soccer games think about 4 and a few foot ball managers

comments.author: Swimming_Resort_1059
comments.body:
Most are average devs and shit bricks when you introduce some level of physics or dynamism.

The dev market is flooded with hypercasual/mobile builder similar to how app market is filled with those games.

People hating fifa on delivering same shit doesnt fathom the level of engineering they embed in the game.
Specially IK and Physics on local as well as the network.

replies.author: Negative-Carob-6122
replies.body: they all had good reviews on fiver at least they did the right thing by refusing instead of trying to make a game from scratch, I think they are used to niche games, game would suppose to be a remach game, more than fifa (before rematch even existed btw xD)

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body: nobody uses inverse kinematics for soccer

replies.author: Swimming_Resort_1059
replies.body:
They do actually.

You can refer to the gdc presentation by EA developers Paul McComas and Jason Sanmiya, titled Animation Warping for Responsiveness in FIFA Soccer.

Overall a decent one where they explain their approach.

comments.author: 1relytnotyals
comments.body: I’m working on one right now actually

replies.author: 1relytnotyals
replies.body: Mine is more cozy though. I think FIFA/ea is still solid for realistic gameplay

replies.author: Russ_72days
replies.body: Looking like how we consume football on TV has near zero correlation to how it feels to play football. There is a wide open space for decent football games now that AI is cutting down the complexity of development. Watch this space 🤓🤓

replies.author: 1relytnotyals
replies.body: I feel that. But as a baller and a gamer playing FIFA and scoring or shitting on someone still feels good (not 100% the same intensity obviously) as if you did it in real life

replies.author: 1relytnotyals
replies.body: There’s a difference between capturing feelings and emotions and simulating hyper realism. There’s far less money at the moment in the latter.

comments.author: Salmj00
comments.body: it depends. If you're aiming for a realistic football game, good luck dealing with player and ball animations or physics, not to mention the AI systems and all the underlying details that go into making the gameplay feel realistic or at least playable.

replies.author: Negative-Carob-6122
replies.body: was 4 years ago im to old for a competitive game like this rn im more for games more chill now

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
> gOoD lUcK wItH pHySiCs

why do you amateurs keep saying this?  did nobody tell you that physics systems are off the shelf components built into the platforms?

physics for a typical soccer game is like ten minutes of work 

it’s so weird watching you guys try to put on shows of deep sophistication to make fun of each other when you don’t know what average sixteen year olds know

comments.author: SnooStories251
comments.body:
A realistic soccer game is very hard. You compete with big titles that have perfected everything for 40 years.

You need to swap up the genre or formula somehow.

I really liked bloodbowl, fifa, rocket ligue and football manager, so that shows the football game can be altered into new fun directions.

replies.author: Negative-Carob-6122
replies.body: It was for Roblox, eventually some games did similar things to what I had thought and became successful

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectul to others and follow reddits guidelines and policies.
